programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 2: Stories from the Stud
programme.desc: This week Ride seeks out the scorching sands of Kuwait where the Arabian Horse reigns supreme, skims the surf on the Emerald Isle with the Connemara Ponies of Cashel Bay Stud and recognises the dressage stars of the future at the home of Germany’s Olympic Gold Medalist Sonke Rothenberger.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 3: Horses & Heritage
programme.desc: This week Ride travels back in time on the UK’s waterways aboard one of the last remaining horse drawn Barges. We fly high in California with Karrie Rufer, star of the Longines FEI Jumping World Cup North American League, step out with the sure-footed shires as they “Relay” acrross rural England, and witness the spectacle that is the dancing Spanish stallions at the Royal Andalusian School in Jerez.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 1
programme.desc: We begin this chapter rating and voting the student boxes organization at the stables and learning some tips on how horses should be taken care of in the stables. We will clean our equipment properly before feeding the horses and then we will be receiving Doctor Menegon, the voice for the Italian and International horse-riding competitions and introducing our special guest Rolf-Göran Bengtsson. Tune in on the Episode 2 Chapter 1 of Horse Academy Pro, exclusively on HorseTV!

programme.title: Jumping International de Dinard - Tropicana Derby of Dinard
programme.desc: The mythical Tropicana Derby is one of the categories inside the Jumping International de Dinard, and it offers a combination of traditional and natural fences over a particularly long distance of 1100m that will bring both horse and rider to their limit. Relive the best moments of Dinards Tropicana Derby with a jumping height over 1.45m.

programme.title: FEI Eventing Nations Cup - Episode 4 - Arville
programme.desc: The FEI Eventing Nations Cup is back with leg 4 in Belgium! Teams reunite in Arville to compete in eventing and become the best nation in the equestrian sport. Last time, France moved to the top in Le Pin au Haras, and competition is proving to be complicated. Are you ready for the challenge?Watch the best moments of the fourth leg in Arville.

programme.title: FEI Eventing Nations Cup - Episode 5 - Boekelo
programme.desc: Boekelo, in The Netherlands, is the last stop of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup 2021. Team Sweden wants to repeat their victory from 2019 and as defending champions they will deliver a top sport performance. However, Great Britain is on the lead of this leg with 80.8 points thanks to the stellar performance of Fox-Pitt and Nicola Wilson. Will this be enough to earn the title? Find out now in the final leg of the FEI Eventing Nations Cup 2021.

programme.title: German High Goal Polo Championship - German High Goal Polo Championship
programme.desc: The German Polo Tour has been the top polo league in Germany since 2010. Now, rivalling teams will have to compete in the Prussian & Country Club Berlin-Brandenburg for the Cup. The final between Carfactory and Riller & Schmauck is now on. Enjoy the competition and follow the top level of german polo in Horse TV.

programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to The Polo Show. The program about the most spectacular horse events all around. Adrenaline and glamour combined with great speed and passion are part of the first episode of the season. We travel around the United States, Thailand and Dubai discovering the latest polo events happening. Let's share the journey!

programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: Today we bring you some of the highlights from the season finale in the USA as well as the start of the season in England. We are also going to take a look at the action from Italy and France. Join us on a worldwide polo journey across all continents and discover this passionated sport that is linked in many countries to royalty.

Sunshine Tour - Week 3

This is the last clear round for some riders to qualify for the Young Horse Finals held next week. Are you ready?

programme.title: Le Grand Prix du Faubourg
programme.desc: Relive the highlights of the CSI 5stars accumulator competition against the clock over obstacles from 1.50 -1.60 m height, progressive difficulties and with a joker.

programme.title: Arte Equestre TV - Episode 1 - Italian Cowboy Dressage Championship 2021
programme.desc: After several years without an event, Uaipre decided to organize the Italian Cowboy Dressage Championship 2021, and for the surprise of many, it was a huge success. The time needed to organize the event was very limited due to changes in organization, but the will and compromise of all organisers saw outstanding performances from the Italian cowboy dressage riders. We participate in the event and interview both organizers and participants to grasp their overall impressions.

programme.title: Longines FEI Nations Cup - 2019 La Baule Competition
programme.desc: La Baule welcomes leaders of the jumping competition at the François André stadium for the first stage of the European Division 1 of the Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup series. For four days, teams from all nationalities will compete with their teams for the delight of spectators.Watch the full competition of the Longines FEI Nations Cup in La Baule.

programme.title: Jumping International Le Saut Hermès - Highlights Prix du 24 Faubourg
programme.desc: After the famous Le Saut Hermès, the Prix du 24 Faubourg is also a competition with a classification of CSI5* but this time with point accumulation and against the clock. With obstacles from 1.50m to 1.60m, it is a big challenge with a progressive difficulty as rider and horse advance on the course. Relive the best moments of the Prix du 24 Faubourg in its 2019 edition.

Sunshine Tour - Week 4
programme.desc: A surprising amount of horses have made an appearance in the fourth week of the CSI3* of the Sunshine Tour. As 153 horses jumped in the 1.50m, Big Tour D class, it had to be divided in two sections. All the other sections of the competition had incredible outcomes as Dutch rider Kim Emmen continues to dominate the 6yr old section. Are you ready for the best showjumping action of the Sunshine Tour 2020? Let's rewind on the fourth week of the competition!

programme.title: Jumping International La Baule - Derby
programme.desc: The Derby at La Baule is an awaited event amongst horse enthusiasts. Classified as a CSIO 5*, competitors rush against the clock for a prize money of 40,000 euros. They will have to beat all sort of obstacles with a height of 1.45m across the field. The competition is hard and not all combinations are ready to challenge the fences, water and ramps in the way.Watch the best moments of the 2019 competition.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 8 - Stockholm

As one of the hardest jump offs this season, who will make it to the top in Sweden? Watch the highlights of the Longines Global Champions Tour Stockholm Grand Prix!

programme.title: German High Goal Polo Championship - German High Goal Polo Championship
programme.desc: The German Polo Tour has been the top polo league in Germany since 2010. Now, rivalling teams will have to compete in the Prussian & Country Club Berlin-Brandenburg for the Cup. The final between Carfactory and Riller & Schmauck is now on. Enjoy the competition and follow the top level of german polo in Horse TV.

programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to The Polo Show. The program about the most spectacular horse events all around. Adrenaline and glamour combined with great speed and passion are part of the first episode of the season. We travel around the United States, Thailand and Dubai discovering the latest polo events happening. Let's share the journey!

programme.title: The Polo Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: Today we bring you some of the highlights from the season finale in the USA as well as the start of the season in England. We are also going to take a look at the action from Italy and France. Join us on a worldwide polo journey across all continents and discover this passionated sport that is linked in many countries to royalty.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Week 4
programme.desc: A surprising amount of horses have made an appearance in the fourth week of the CSI3* of the Sunshine Tour. As 153 horses jumped in the 1.50m, Big Tour D class, it had to be divided in two sections. All the other sections of the competition had incredible outcomes as Dutch rider Kim Emmen continues to dominate the 6yr old section. Are you ready for the best showjumping action of the Sunshine Tour 2020? Let's rewind on the fourth week of the competition!

programme.title: Jumping International La Baule - Derby
programme.desc: The Derby at La Baule is an awaited event amongst horse enthusiasts. Classified as a CSIO 5*, competitors rush against the clock for a prize money of 40,000 euros. They will have to beat all sort of obstacles with a height of 1.45m across the field. The competition is hard and not all combinations are ready to challenge the fences, water and ramps in the way.Watch the best moments of the 2019 competition.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 2: Stories from the Stud
programme.desc: This week Ride seeks out the scorching sands of Kuwait where the Arabian Horse reigns supreme, skims the surf on the Emerald Isle with the Connemara Ponies of Cashel Bay Stud and recognises the dressage stars of the future at the home of Germany’s Olympic Gold Medalist Sonke Rothenberger.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 3: Horses & Heritage
programme.desc: This week Ride travels back in time on the UK’s waterways aboard one of the last remaining horse drawn Barges. We fly high in California with Karrie Rufer, star of the Longines FEI Jumping World Cup North American League, step out with the sure-footed shires as they “Relay” acrross rural England, and witness the spectacle that is the dancing Spanish stallions at the Royal Andalusian School in Jerez.

programme.title: Banorte Trophy - Highlights

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 1 - Isabell Werth
programme.desc: One of the most successful dressage riders in history, Isabell Werth has already won 10 Olympic medals. She has won five team gold medals with the German team as well as the individual title in 1996. With a computer game in her name, she is a legend in the equestrian industry. Let's look back on her career that spans 30 years.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 2 - Peder Fredricson
programme.desc: In episode 2 we are focussing on one of the most revered names in the world of showjumping today, two-time Olympic silver medalist, Peder Fredricson. Born in Södertälje, Sweden, he has won two olympic silver medals: on in team jumping at the 2004 Athens Olympics and a second one in individual jumping at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

programme.title: CHIO Aachen - Best Moments
programme.desc: Words speak for themselves. An equestrian show unrivalled anywhere in the world, offering the highest level of performance. The CHIO Aachen is probably the most prestigious horse show in Europe when it comes to show jumping and dressage. Riders compete against each other in this episode for victory in the show jumping competition. Relive all the magic moments of the 2019 edition of the CHIO Aachen.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Episode 1 - CSI4 * Andalucía Grand Prix
programme.desc: With a CSI4* rating, the Sunshine Tour is one of Europe’s toughest competitions. Here, a single mistake could mean the end of the competition.Don’t miss the incredible actions of week one of the Spanish Sunshine Tour.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the latest season of Horse Academy Pro. We welcome our new students: Martina, Lucrezia, Magdalena, Julia, Dea, Carlota and Zoe to the equestrian facilities, and they start getting ready to warm up and receive training from Bruno Chimirri as well as from our trainer, Diego. Find out how their first day to become PROs goes on Horse Academy Pro!

programme.title: The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 3 - Igrid Klimke
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic names in the equestrian world, German eventer Ingrid Klimke. With her horse Abraxxas, she won two gold medals in team eventing at the 2008 and 2012 Olympic Games. Despite never thinking she would have a career with horses, now she is an extremely successful rider.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 4 - Charlotte Dujardin
programme.desc: Charlotte Dujardin is a british dressage rider, equestrian and writer. She is probably the most successful British dressage rider in history, holder of three Dressage world records and winning major titles in international competitions with only 35 years. She is the Olympic dressage champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016. In this episode, we find out what drives her towards success.

programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic names in the equestrian world, German eventer Ingrid Klimke. With her horse Abraxxas, she won two gold medals in team eventing at the 2008 and 2012 Olympic Games. Despite never thinking she would have a career with horses, now she is an extremely successful rider.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 4 - Charlotte Dujardin
programme.desc: Charlotte Dujardin is a british dressage rider, equestrian and writer. She is probably the most successful British dressage rider in history, holder of three Dressage world records and winning major titles in international competitions with only 35 years. She is the Olympic dressage champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016. In this episode, we find out what drives her towards success.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the latest season of Horse Academy Pro. We welcome our new students: Martina, Lucrezia, Magdalena, Julia, Dea, Carlota and Zoe to the equestrian facilities, and they start getting ready to warm up and receive training from Bruno Chimirri as well as from our trainer, Diego. Find out how their first day to become PROs goes on Horse Academy Pro!

programme.title: The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Moscow Polo Club vs Hamburger Polo Club
programme.desc: In order to advance to the following rounds, Moscow Polo Club will have to face Hamburger Polo Club in this first stage of the Polo Rider Cup 2021. With a 10/12 goals handicap and 5 chukkers, competition between the strongest polo teams in the world is on at the Polo Club de Chantilly. Enjoy the match between Moscow Polo Club and Hamburger Polo Club.

She is probably the most successful British dressage rider in history, holder of three Dressage world records and winning major titles in international competitions with only 35 years. She is the Olympic dressage champion at London 2012 and Rio 2016. In this episode, we find out what drives her towards success.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Episode 5 - Nations Cup Victoria Trophy

This means all riders are eager to perform their best to reach the top in the Spanish facilities. Watch the best moments of the 2021 competition.

programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic names in the equestrian world, German eventer Ingrid Klimke. He talks about the bond between a horse and rider, how he manages stress at competitions and the mental preparation he undergoes when detecting possible problems in the field. Then, the students get on the reins to practice jumps.

programme.title: Jumping International de Dinard - Grand Prix
programme.desc: The acclaimed CSI5* Grand Prix de la Ville de Dinard is, together with the Derby, one of the top events of the Jumping International de Dinard. Top equestrians from all around the world gather to try their best against the clock in this physically-straining course. Discover the outcome of the Grand Prix 2019.

programme.title: Vaulting Season Review - Review
programme.desc: Vaulters seek the chance to make it to Dortmund, Germany, and compete in the Vaulting 2016-2017 season final. However, before getting to the German city, they have to qualify in the events taking place all over Europe. Competing in Individual Female, Individual Male and Pas-de-Deux, vaulters will prove they bond with their horses in an incredible performance.Enjoy the best moments of the 2016-2017 vaulting season.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 5 - Boyd Exell
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on one of the most iconic name in the sport of carriage driving, the Australian Boyd Exell. Fascinated by horses from a very young age, he moved to the United Kingdom to develop this early talent, and soon he became the first Athlete in history of the sport to compete in three different World Championships: horse singles, horse pairs and four in hand.

programme.title: FEI Icons - Episode 6 - Martin Fuchs
programme.desc: FEI Icons is a series looking back at the careers of some of the most successful and influential equestrian athletes of the 21st century. In this episode, we are focussing on the Swiss sensation, Martin Fuchs, who at only 27 years old had already propelled himself to the top of the Show jumping world. Discover his story.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
Polo Rider Cup Competition - Dos Lunas Polo Club vs Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz
programme.desc: Dos Lunas Polo Club is facing Evviva Polo Saint-Moritz in this heated game at the Polo Rider Cup 2021. Playing with a 10/12 goals handicap and 5 chukkers, both teams will try their best to keep advancing in the tournament, but it will not be an easy feat. Watch the best moments of the competition.

programme.title: Polo Rider Cup Competition - Polo Club de Chantilly vs Polo Park Zürich
programme.desc: The hosting team, Polo Club de Chantilly, is ready to take Polo Park Zürich in this game for the Polo Rider Cup. However, Park Zürich has been preparing diligently for this moment and is one of the strongest teams in the competition. Who will be the winner in this game? Find out on the Polo Rider Cup 2021 Competition.

programme.title: El Peluquero Romántico
programme.desc: La vida del barbero de barrio Víctor transcurre bastante tranquila. Mantiene una estricta rutina diaria tanto en el trabajo como en casa, donde pasa las noches junto a su madre escuchando boleros o viendo películas de la Época de Oro del Cine Mexicano en la televisión. Su rutina se ve alterada cuando su madre muere repentinamente. Su coqueteo con una joven camarera y su reencuentro con una antigua novia no pueden llenar el vacío dejado por su madre. Sin embargo, eso cambia cuando un día un hombre que dice ser su padre entra repentinamente a la tienda. El encuentro lo llevará a un viaje inesperado y que le cambiará la vida a Río de Janeiro.

programme.title: Aquel Septiembre
programme.desc: En "Septiembre" la vida de Antonio se ve sacudida con el regreso de Carolina, su mejor amigo a quien no ve desde hace 6 años. Esta vez sus planes cambian, el amor comienza a juega con su corazón mientras Julián le hace descubrir los celos que nunca pensó encontraría. Carolina encuentra en Antonio a su mejor confidente y desahogo, sin sabiendo el daño que le hace al decirle todo lo que siente por Julián y hablando con él sobre su confusión por enamorarse de un amigo. Y es que pobre Antonio está enamorado de Carolina, su mejor amiga.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: Cena Para Tres
programme.desc: Diego regresa a México después de dictar cátedra de arquitectura en Madrid y se encuentra con su antiguo amor, Carmen. Planea una cena para dos para despedir el año. Carmen asume que esa noche Diego le pedirá matrimonio pero la llegada inesperada de Valentina (su novia española) y la revelación del pasado secreto de Carmen cambiarán el destino de los personajes.

programme.title: El Viaje De La Nonna
programme.desc: A la Nonna, abuela de los Todaro, se le olvida todo. Todo menos que quiere ir a la tierra de su amado y difunto marido, Italia, con toda su familia, antes de que también se le olvide que tiene familia. Acorralados por la insistencia de la Nonna y queriendo darle un último gusto, la familia decide concederle su añorado viaje. Así pues, todos se embarcan en una aventura en búsqueda de imágenes para la memoria de la abuela; en un viaje lleno de enredos y sorpresas inherentes a la situación, pero, sobre todo, de amor.

programme.title: 20,000 Besos
programme.desc: Juan es un treintañero que está aburrido con su vida actual. Hace tiempo que no ve a sus amigos y solo se dedica a trabajar –en un lugar aburrido– y a hacer de novio. Abrumado de rutina, un día se separa "sin rumbo fijo". Luego de pasar unas noches en la casa de su amigo Goldstein, él va comenzando a recuperar todo lo que estaba olvidado. Se alquila un departamento, se reencuentra con sus amigos y cuando comienza a disfrutar de su vida de recién separado, su jefe le asigna un trabajo junto a Luciana, una compañera de la oficina. Lo que al principio parece una tontería se convierte en un tedio. Juan no tolera en nada a Luciana. Pero por esas cosas raras que a veces suceden, Juan comienza a enamorarse de ella. ¿Estará recuperando sus encantos de soltero? ¿O está por cometer el mayor error de su vida sentimental?

programme.title: Bajo Un Manto De Estrellas
programme.desc: Verano de 1936. El convento dominico de Almagro se vacía en los primeros días del mes de julio. Novicios y estudiantes son enviados a diversos lugares de España para pasarlas vacaciones, reduciéndose así los habitantes del edificio a una veintena de frailes de todas las edades. El 18 de julio el ejército de África se levanta en armas contra el gobierno de la República, lo que supondrá, por las circunstancias políticas del momento, una severa amenaza para los religiosos. En el nerviosismo expectante de los primeros días, la cosa no pasó de visitas molestas e indagaciones suspicaces, pero cuando presenciaron el incendio de la cercana parroquia Madre de Dios, ya no les cupo duda de la tormenta que se cernía sobre sus cabezas.

programme.title: Distopia
programme.desc: Impulsados por antiguos planes esotéricos, poderosas elites ocultas emplean armas bioquímicas, guerra psicológica, cuarentenas mundiales, e incluso magia negra para controlar el futuro de la humanidad y alcanzar la inmortalidad

programme.title: Eros Una Vez María
programme.desc: María es el gran amor de Tonatiuh, pero él la pierde. Intenta mantener su esencia, buscando incansablemente en cada mujer que conoce, tratando de obtener tantas experiencias sobre ellas como pueda, para poder encontrar algo que le recuerde a su amor perdido. Todas esas mujeres tienen una particularidad: se llaman María.

programme.title: Choele
programme.desc: Todo ocurre en el pueblo de Choele Choel, provincia de Río Negro. Un niño y su padre intentan seguir juntos todo el verano, pero el chico ya decidió partir hacia otro lugar con su madre, cuando ésta llegue y le recoja. A la zona donde viven llega una chica, por la que comienzan a competir padre e hijo.

programme.title: El Campeón
programme.desc: LA HISTORIA DE UNA PROMESA DEL BOXEO, SU ENTRENADOR SOLO LO USA PARA BENEFICIO PROPIO. LA FAMA Y EL DINERO SOLO LE TRAE PROBLEMAS, ADEMAS QUE SUFAMILIA SE APROVECHA DE EL.

programme.title: Dos Abrazos
programme.desc: Cuatro personas que se ven forzadas a defenderse ante la vida, un ensimismado chico de doce años, la cajera que tiene un encuentro con él, un airado conductor de taxi y la enajenada hija de uno de sus pasajeros, se reúnen en dos abrazos.

programme.title: El Ultimo Verano
programme.desc: Carlos es un Profesor de universidad a punto de jubilarse, pero su futuro se ve en peligro porque una de sus alumnas lo acusa de haber sido acosada. Esto es solo el inicio de la peor racha de su vida ya que Carlos descubre que su esposa lo engaña y que la vida que el creía perfecta se esfuma poco a poco de sus manos... tal vez sea el ultimo verano en la vida de Carlos

programme.title: Espacio Interior
programme.desc: Lázaro permanece secuestrado en un cuarto de tres metros cuadrados completamente aislado del mundo exterior. Obligado a revelar información íntima sobre sus familiares, cae en una desidia total. Al borde de la muerte, se da cuenta, esperanzado, de que su voluntad y su mente nunca podrán ser secuestrados. Es posible que jamás lo liberen, pero su gran fe y dignidad le muestran la inquebrantable naturaleza del espíritu humano.

programme.title: El Deseo de Domingo
programme.desc: Narra la historia de Domingo, un adulto mayor que sufre Alzheimer y pasa sus días en un geriátrico en la ciudad de Viedma, desde donde intenta, a toda costa, viajar a la Capital, a San Isidro, a ver el gran premio de turf Carlos Pellegrini. Pero claro, no se trata de cualquier premio, sino el del año 1952. Para eso necesitará de la ayuda de Marcelo, su nieto, quien se encuentra en el dilema de conformarse con su puesto en una dependencia pública o seguir luchando por triunfar con su banda de rock. …

programme.title: Cuando Yo Te Vuelva a Ver
programme.desc: Treinta años después de haberse radicado en España, Paco regresa a la Argentina para apadrinar la boda de un amigo. Retirado y separado de su esposa española, se reencuentra con sus afectos. Como siempre, en los últimos treinta años, Margarita, ya jubilada como docente, arrastra hacia adelante su vida. En la fiesta de casamiento, Paco como padrino y Margarita como encargada del servicio de catering, se cruzan nuevamente aunque sin encontrarse, hasta que él la descubre en un video de la fiesta. El amor truncado por la ausencia y la negativa de ella a responder sus cartas, vuelve a renacer en una búsqueda por recuperar el tiempo perdido.

programme.title: Bruma
programme.desc: Martina se siente atrapada en una vida encasillada en la Ciudad de México. Al enterarse de su embarazo y sin saber qué hacer al respecto, decide ir a Berlín en busca del padre, e inicia un viaje donde encontrará su propia identidad.

programme.title: El Ultimo Fin de Semana
programme.desc: Diana quiere celebrar su próximo ascenso. Invita a la casa de su abuela a sus compañeros de trabajo, para pasar el fin de semana “perfecto”. Pero el pueblo esconde un gran secreto. Se dedican a pasar tres días de fiesta, sol, playa y alcohol. Aflorarán rencores, confesiones, deseo sexual, celos, tensiones… pero no están solos como creen y puede que, para más de uno, éste sea su último fin de semana

Corre el año 2097 que después de 30 años de paz y prosperidad se ha erradicado la letal pandemia del virus del 2067.Pero una sombra se cierne sobre las comunidades de supervivientes. Un espectro que vuelve para atormentar a aquellos que desterraron la causa de la pandemia logrando retornar a la supervivencia necesaria para sobrevivir a pesar de la lección sufrida por la humanidad desde el 2067

programme.title: Faraday
programme.desc: Faraday es un telépata especialista en fenómenos paranormales. Su novia, Pati, es una bloguera entregada a los cupcakes cuya máxima aspiración en la vida es ser famosa en internet. Alquilan un piso muy barato en el que al fin podrán independizarse, pero una vez instalados descubren que está encantado. “Faraday” es una historia de amor que supera todas las fronteras, incluidas las del Más Allá. Una comedia paranormal que tocará la fibra a todos aquellos que alguna vez han deseado ser “modernos”

programme.title: Club Habana
programme.desc: Bárbara es una estudiante de Artes Plásticas, que viajará a España para presentar una exposición de pinturas. Camino a una fiesta de despedida, le sorprende una tormenta y tiene que refugiarse en un viejo y decadente club nocturno al que asisten personas con intereses muy diversos y, en ocasiones, opuestos.

programme.title: Cartero
programme.desc: Hernán Sosa es un joven tímido que viene del interior a la ciudad. En su pueblo siempre estuvo enamorado de una chica inalcanzable, Yanina. Hernán consigue trabajo en el correo. Durante el reparto, Hernán descubre que Yanina se encuentra en la ciudad, en la zona de su reparto. En consecuencia, comienza a desplegar sus nuevos conocimientos de cartero para llegar hasta ella. Pero a medida que se acerca, descubre que unos viejos carteros están organizando un robo en el mismo edificio donde trabaja Yanina. Envalentonado por la fuerza del amor, Hernán se enfrentará a los peligros que rodean a Yanina para llegar a declararle lo que siente.

programme.title: Despertar El Polvo
programme.desc: Es la historia de un hombre que ha sufrido las desgracias de vivir una vida trasgredida por la delincuencia y corrupción, el barrio de Iztapalapa es el escenario donde vaga por las calles, invisible, ignorado y solitario, sumido en su miseria. Un evento desafortunado mueve el instinto protector de Chano que intenta regresar al mundo del crimen para lograr sacar a su ahijado de la cárcel.

programme.title: En Un Lugar De La Mancha
programme.desc: En una pequeña localidad de La Mancha, Isabel y Silvia, cansadas de esconder su pasión, deciden marcharse un fin de semana a la casa rural que alquila el sacerdote de un pueblo cercano. Pronto lamentarán su decisión.

programme.title: Side-B
programme.desc: Wang Li-Sheng ha conocido a una chica española en Internet y ha decidido dejarlo todo y vivir su historia de amor en España. Las cosas no salen como él esperaba y acaba sin novia, sin dinero y sin pasaporte, por lo que tiene que buscarse la vida como inmigrante ilegal en un país del que no sabe nada. Su suerte cambiará cuando conozca a Marisa, una soñadora de sangre caliente que ha encontrado su lugar en este país; y a Mioara, una chica de Bucarest que llegó hace dos años buscando trabajo. Como suele ocurrir cuando somos jóvenes y las cosas suceden demasiado deprisa, sus corazones llevarán a estos desconocidos de los árboles por caminos no demasiado rectos.

programme.title: Las Puertas del Infierno [Insidious Inferno]
programme.desc: Una cabaña aislada está plagada de una serie de horribles asesinatos, sin que los habitantes lo sepan, algo de otro mundo acecha dentro de los pasillos.

programme.title: Maid
programme.desc: Cuando su señora contrata a otra sirvienta para que la ayude en las tareas domésticas, una criada amargada e introvertida causa estragos en la casa.

programme.title: Exorcismo En El Vientre [Exorcism in Utero]
programme.desc: Una mujer embarazada debe encontrar la forma de salvarse a sí misma y a su bebé después de encontrar un poderoso anillo que la posee cuando se lo prueba.

programme.title: Eva + Candela
programme.desc: La ambición profesional de dos mujeres fuertes e independientes las une, pero también es lo que finalmente las separa, mientras somos testigos de cómo su intenso amor se metamorfosea en medio de etapas de enamoramiento, sensualidad, amor, comodidad y, finalmente, rutina.

programme.title: Día 13
programme.desc: Colton está enamorado de su nueva vecina Heather, pero teme que su padre adoptivo sea parte de un culto satánico. Él trata de protegerla y descubre que la verdad es más horrible.

programme.title: Cut Her Out
programme.desc: Darcy no puede purgar su mente de los abusos animales que sufrió de niña a manos de su madre. Ryan, el terapeuta de Darcy, descubre que la granja de su familia ha sido abandonada.

programme.title: Girl Gets Girl
programme.desc: Basada en la exitosa serie web española «Chica busca chica», Inés vive una vida encantadora con su bella novia. Todo su mundo se pone patas arriba cuando pierde un plazo de entrega por estar demasiado ocupada seduciendo a todas las mujeres atractivas con las que se cruza. Sin trabajo, sin dinero y sin novia, Inés se enfrenta a una existencia desconocida en un día de locura.

programme.title: Visiones Mortales [Scalper]
programme.desc: Todos a su alrededor, la psíquica Clementine Carter, están siendo brutalmente asesinados por un asesino enmascarado apodado "El Escalpador". ¿Es el psicópata muerto Andrew Lubitz vuelto de la tumba, un asesino imitador o un horror más allá de la imaginación? Clementine debe usar su segundo sentido para mantenerse un paso adelante de la cuchilla del maníaco y resolver el misterio.

programme.title: Until You Untie Me
programme.desc: Una joven bailarina se sume en una desesperación emocional tras perder a su familia en un accidente mortal. Su camino de autodestrucción se enreda con un médico infame por mala praxis. Su encuentro desemboca en una febril historia de amor que explora el fetichismo, el sadomasoquismo y el bondage.

programme.title: Sadomaster
programme.desc: La violencia urbana extrema reina en Argentina. El senador Beccar Varela se alza como la única forma de frenar la violencia con su política de «tolerancia cero». La gente no sospecha que Beccar es el jefe de la banda nazi que provoca la violencia. Cuando los miembros de la banda torturan y violan a un retrasado, un misterioso vengador enmascarado comienza su brutal venganza contra las bandas y los políticos corruptos.

programme.title: City of Vultures 3
programme.desc: Richard joins in the drug trade, as advocates for reform urge him to change. G attempts to raise his son on Chicago's violent south side.

programme.title: A Gun for Jennifer
programme.desc: A woman comes to New York City from Ohio to escape an abusive husband and gets entangled with murderous female vigilantes who prey on abusive men.

programme.desc: A baby is kidnapped in a Brazilian airport. Years later, the mother lives in Lisbon and works in a strip-tease bar so she can survive. When she is fired, she joins a gang of bank robbers...

programme.title: Alien Rising
programme.desc: A savvy ex-homeland security agent and martial arts expert is forced to a remote island to help the military unlock the secrets of an extraterrestrial technology.

programme.title: Anonymous
programme.desc: Artemis and Cash set out to take down a child sex trafficking ring and, in doing so discover Artemis' long lost son, only to find there are grave consequences that may cost them their lives and the ones they love. Unbeknownst to Artemis, the hard core enforcer, Olivier (Ernest L. Thomas -What's Happening, Malcolm X, Everybody Hates Chris) is also searching for the boy and willing to do anything to find him.

programme.title: Beyond the Night
programme.desc: When a soldier's son reveals damning information about a local gangster's missing daughter, a war of attrition wreaks havoc on their forgotten coal mining town.

programme.title: Beyond
programme.desc: Two brothers runs the neighborhood gang, tries to hide their true identities from their mom by pretending to have a day job, but faces a deeper problems when the ruthless mafia boss asks them to do a job for them. The simple job turns into protecting their homeland against neighboring country's mafia to use their land to expand their dirty business.

programme.desc: Carlo, a steel worker, has been laid off from his job. He's married to his high school sweetheart, a cancer survivor. They have a special needs teenage son. programme.title: Deadly Reckoning
programme.desc: Ernest Gray is a bookstore owner who lives peacefully with his daughter. When a crew of mercenaries attacks, his real identity of an ex-CIA agent is blown. Control 5, who betrayed him ten years ago, is on his trail again.

programme.title: Death Rattle Crystal Ice
programme.desc: Meth, murder and mayhem cooked up by a crooked Sheriff and his gang of misfits is battled by a Special Ops Agent seeking payback for his brother's death at their hands.

programme.title: DV8

programme.desc: Four young people get sucked into a time bending vortex to an apocalyptic future where women rule the earth.

programme.title: H.P. Lovecraft's The Old Ones

programme.title: Aliens Uncovered: Marilyn Monroe Exposed
programme.desc: With UFO abductions and close encounters, did the President attempt to disclose information in an unorthodox way, warning us of what was to come?

programme.title: Lost at War
programme.desc: This is a Twilight Zone type story that involves five soldiers out on a mission who soon find themselves stuck in a foxhole in an apparently deserted camp. Then strange things begin to happen.

programme.title: Variant
programme.desc: When an artist struggling for purpose meets a mysterious yet charming stranger, she becomes entangled in his twisted attempts to 'relive the perfect moment'.

programme.title: Night of the Beast (aka Lucas child)
programme.desc: Lukas Armand, a skull-faced movie producer, is auditioning lovely young starlets for his upcoming low-budget Horror pic. The girls are delighted to learn they've been chosen to star in the film until Lukas' creepy gofers, Jason and Mad-dog kidnap the actresses, one by one, and lock the terrified girls in dank cells somewhere in the bowels of the film studio.

programme.title: Await the Dawn
programme.desc: A troubled family traveling cross country are highjacked by a desperate man. Only to discover he's running from something more dangerous than he is.

programme.title: The Final Shift
programme.desc: The tranquil haven of AL's Diner, harboring a scant collective of employees, patrons (including a hit man and his partner, a beautiful woman with a dark secret) and a devout Christian family, is thrown into chaos when a callow gang of four enters with a duffel bag of invaluable contents. After the gang's attempt to deliver the contents to the powerful and shady Maslow is derailed when one of them murders a cop inside the diner, suspicions and revelations arise among the group. While the gang struggles to keep control over the situation as more the police arrive, they quickly realize this is the least of their problems when Maslow comes to claim the contents of the bag.

programme.title: Windstorm
programme.desc: Chaos. Disease. War and rumors of war throughout the world. Is this the end? For a group of strangers caught together fleeing Los Angeles, the answers are not so clear. And as the group takes shelter in the midst of a storm, one thing becomes apparent? the dangers of the world outside are nothing compared to what dwells among them in the shelter.

programme.title: The Misty Green Sky
programme.desc: A young girl in another solar system asks an innocent question that sets off a chain reaction of adventure, destruction and tragedy.

programme.title: Two Chefs and a Wedding Cake

programme.desc: After being home-schooled, Sky can't wait to get back into the high school experience and make some friends. But, when her new gang seems to prefer shoplifting to hanging out, Sky wonders whether she's fallen in with the wrong crowd.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila accepts that Max is the man she has loved the most and confides that she feels a great hatred for Marcelina, because being her mother's best friend, she was the one who betrayed her the worst and left her in the street, when she was only a five year old girl. Max refuses to believe it.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Patricia, crying, denies having killed Celso. Fausto manipulates the children into believing that their mother is the killer and must turn herself in. Camila eloquently presents her version of events and then tells Ezequiel that he lied to make Patricia pay for a crime she didn't commit, just like they did with their mother.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila, in order to make Patricia live the same anguish that her mother must have felt, will offer her help and then expose her publicly. Camila has the recorded video of what happened with Celso and the condition for not handing it over to the police is that Fausto tells how his mother was incriminated.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila offers Patricia to hand over the video, only if she betrays Fausto and gives it to the police. Patricia tells Camila that her mother was not such a saint and that she was the cause of this war between the families, because of her relationship with two men at the same time. Fausto hires Anton again to kill his wife.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto and Ezequiel confront each other; the video that projects Celso's death will sink Fausto unless he signs a confession where he clarifies that Rosa Blanco was unjustly condemned. Fausto manipulates saying that Ezequiel also confesses that he killed his brother Augusto, Camila's father. She arrives in time to stop Ezequiel from shooting Fausto.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto, narrates in detail what happened years ago. He lies blatantly, Torrealba thinks he wants to blame his wife for having been unfaithful to him. Camila reproaches Mother Isabel harshly. Rosa cannot appear because they want to kill her. Axel, disappointed because Amelia hid the paternity of his son from him.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel in conflict with his children. Camila defends them and tells him that her children are afraid of him. Max is willing to meet Rosa, even at the risk of his life and Camila organizes a party to unmask Elda.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila pressures Alfredo by continuing with her plan, she reveals that Alfredo is her godmother's son, whom she abandoned when he was almost born. Elda alone, crying, because deep down she is not happy with what she did. Sebastian, shocked, when Axel confesses that Amelia's son is his.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max informs Camila that he knows the whereabouts of Rosa Blanco. Fausto enjoys harassing Patricia and that he will pay, like Rosa Blanco, for a crime he did not commit. Alfredo goes to talk to Elda, he despises her as a mother, guilt and remorse torment her: it is part of the revenge for his betrayal of Rosa Blanco.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max now understands why Camila did not marry him. Max and Camila meet with Rosa. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila offers Patricia to hand over the video, only if she betrays Fausto and gives it to the police. Patricia tells Camila that her mother was not such a saint and that she was the cause of this war between the families, because of her relationship with two men at the same time. Fausto hires Anton again to kill his wife.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto and Ezequiel confront each other; the video that projects Celso's death will sink Fausto unless he signs a confession where he clarifies that Rosa Blanco was unjustly condemned. programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto, narrates in detail what happened years ago. He lies blatantly, Torrealba thinks he wants to blame his wife for having been unfaithful to him. programme.desc: Ezequiel in conflict with his children. Camila defends them and tells him that her children are afraid of him. Max is willing to meet Rosa, even at the risk of his life and Camila organizes a party to unmask Elda.

programme.title: Glass Animals interview - Joe Seaward
programme.desc: Joe about gearing up towards the third album Dreamland, suffering a terrible accident, a time for reflection, not taking things for granted, finding out who the people around you really are, the first rehearsal after the accident, the songwriting for Dreamland, Your Love, how he connects with all of the songs on the album, songs that make you feel, not being able to tour the album, finding new ways to present the album.

programme.title: DMA's interview - Tommy O'Dell
programme.desc: Tommy about their show at the Brixton Academy and Liam Gallagher, finding his voice, the album Glow, dance elements, writing lyrics, Silver, staying true to yourself, ambition, not trying to please everyone, Never Before, Criminals and pop, songs that evolve on the road, Life is a Game of Changing, what he learned as a frontman.

programme.title: Katie Melua interview
programme.desc: Katie about her new album No. 8, playing the entire album live, Remind Me To Forget, her first studio album without Mike Batt, changing things up, celebrating great musicianship, working with producer Leo Abrahams, developing as a songwriter, English Manner, her divorce, love propaganda, focusing on what’s important, being adventurous, getting into photography.

programme.title: Joe Satriani interview
programme.desc: Joe about when he was still a beginner on guitar, working hard to get better, NYC in the early 70s, the surrealness of his career, teaching Steve Vai, finding “work-arounds” as a guitar player, Eddie van Halen, The Elephants of Mars, experimentation, composing songs over the internet, songs coming together organically, a song inspired by Questlove, Randy Rhoads and what keeps inspiring him.

programme.title: Declan McKenna interview
programme.desc: Declan about political engagement, making people think, The Kids Don’t Wanna Come Home, confusion, younger generations, his first songs, rowdy live shows, winning over crowds, a sold-out tour, his upcoming debut record, growing as a songwriter

programme.title: DMA's interview - Johnny Took
programme.desc: Johnny about the past 2 years, their loyal fans, early influences and genre-blending, the evolution of their sound, having loads of time in the studio, shaping How Many Dreams?, I Don’t Need To Hide, creating a dynamic live show, old vs new songs, De Carle and pushing boundaries

programme.title: Band of Horses interview - Ben Bridwell
programme.desc: Ben about needing a change, taking a stab at producing the album, the sound of Things Are Great, making a connection, sounding more like himself, Warning Signs, having success, struggling during lockdown, his love for songwriting, being a conduit for songs, being a fan of music first, trusting himself.

programme.title: Myles Kennedy interview
programme.desc: Myles about a road trip through America, getting out of your bubble, his new solo album The Ides of March, slide guitar, the Sifting Through The Fire intro, making sense of the world and songwriting, Get Along, playing the blues, Love Rain Down, the title track, uncertainty about the future, affecting people with music, the need to create, and a lot more! (11/05/2021)

programme.title: Agnes Obel interview
programme.desc: Agnes about playing piano at an early age, starting to write her own songs, lyrics. and melodies, tapping into the stream of inspiration, a great sense of freedom, Myopia, Camera’s Rolling, playing with pitch, knowing when you’re on the right track, experimenting with her voice, vocals vs instrumentals

programme.title: Shaggy interview
programme.desc: Shaggy about his earliest Christmas memories, Raggamuffin Christmas, having good people around you, becoming a brand, why he got into music, welcoming change, always wanting to learn, how the Christmas In The Islands, album got started, Caribbean Christmas parties, the cultural impact of Jamaica, affecting people in a positive way, his favorite live act, what inspires his songwriting, music for the right mood, Bob Marley.

programme.title: SIXX:A.M. interview - James Michael
programme.desc: James about being an observer of life, memories of his childhood, music production back in the day, modern production techniques, the HITS album, maintaining a sense of innocence, living out his rock star dreams, dealing with public notoriety, all having their favorite SIXX:A.M. albums and songs, talking about substance abuse, the connection with their fans, the power and importance of music, music as comfort food, Bat Out Of Hell.

programme.title: Alain Clark interview
programme.desc: Alain over echte connecties maken, de iPad generatie, Sunday Afternoon, de afstand met z’n publiek verkleinen, Michael Jackson, een echo van Bad Therapy, schrijven wat hij voelt, samenwerkingen, kwetsbaarheid en eerlijkheid, Song’s Don’t Die, Joni Mitchell, mensen raken met z’n muziek, clubshows op zondagmiddag

programme.title: Gilbert O'Sullivan interview
programme.desc: Gilbert about performing live, why he started writing songs, The Beatles, the first song he was proud of, Alone Again (naturally), his creative process, the new album Driven and writing melodies, the art of songwriting, working with Mick Hucknall and KT Tunstall, keeping up with modern music, a misunderstood song, the drive to create

programme.title: Floor Jansen interview
programme.desc: Floor about developing her solo career, finding her own sound, her approach to songwriting, Fire, staying connected with her fans, showing her personality on social media, Tuomas’ writing and her own creative expression, working towards an album, new Nightwish songs, still growing as a vocalist, participating in ‘Sing Meinen Song’

programme.title: The Lumineers interview - Wesley Schultz and Jermiah Fraites
programme.desc: Wesley and Jeremiah about Cleopatra, something they learned from U2, how we connect to music, transcending generations, album III, opening up to others, taking the stigma away from addiction, difficult subjects, Gloria, Kurt Cobain, sadness and beauty, telling the truth about addiction, the identities of all their albums, how they see succes, playing the long game, what makes a good song.

programme.title: Monster Magnet interview - Dave Wyndorf
programme.desc: Dave about music in the 60s, the language of counterculture, an amazing fuzz tone, how music is remembered, Hawkwind and bands that deserve more recognition, making a deal with the devil, the band Table Scraps, shaping the album Better Dystopia, art in the internet world, capturing the right sound, Jack White, learning about his voice, Dust’s Learning to Die, dealing with the lockdowns, live music in the 70s, talking vs listening, music as a transportive experience, commenting about society, how musicians get paid, hope for the future, the era of infotainment.

programme.title: Max Cavalera interview
programme.desc: Max about the music his parents played when he was young, bossanova and Opera, his artistic side, finding heavy metal at the right time, a gift for writing angry songs, protecting his rebellious side, a song about cancer, Totem, native tribes in North America, ancestors, Marc Rizzo leaving the band, Eddie van Halen, Cavalera Conspiracy, playing with his brother Igor, revisiting Sepultura albums

programme.title: Fish interview
programme.desc: Fish about keeping busy during luckdown, working on the Weltschmerz album, Script for a Jester’s Tear saving his ass, growing vegetables, looking for silver linings, the global economy, the health services, climate change, where the idea for Weltschmerz came from, his character driven style of writing, mental health, Grace of God, his retirement from music, Marillion getting too big, knowing what he wants to make, taking his time, being tough on his own lyrics, leaving people wanting more, doing a double album, never having been financially motivated, doing exactly what you want.

programme.title: Walking on Cars interview - Patrick and Sorcha
programme.desc: Patrick and Sorcha about being back on the road, growing up around music, shaping ones identity, when Patrick started writing lyrics, feeling pressure for the second album Colours, Monster, a new energy, a deeper emotion, surprising each other, having matured a lot, being completely content with the album, a sense of relief, Coldest Water, having a positive attitude.

programme.title: Steve Vai interview
programme.desc: Steve about dealing with injuries, the start of Inviolate, his very first compositions, how you deal with adversity, Frank Zappa, depression in 20s, Flex-able, removing expectations, Knappsack, genuine inspiration, allowing your creative self to flourish, fantasy goals vs passion, being careful with your ego, getting in toch with your emotions, Avalancha, how he generally writes music, Sandman Cloud Mist, working on new techniques, working with the Metropole Orchestra, Eddie Van Halen.

programme.title: Charlotte Wessels interview
programme.desc: Charlotte about the release of Tales From Six Feet Under Vol. II, creating a setlist with solo material, creating a story with her solo work, songs written for the live show, making sure the songs work on stage, writing a song a month, allowing songs to evolve, Against All Odds, The Phantom Touch, Venus Rising, the struggle for equality, The Final Roadtrip, worries about the future, the musical direction she’s heading in, future plans

programme.title: Ayreon interview - Arjen Lucassen
programme.desc: Arjen about Eddie van Halen, the rock & roll lifestyle, what he has learned from his previous albums, taking risks, the beginning of Transitus, starting with the story, John Carpenter, finding the right vocalists, ghost movies, the plot of Transitus, shorter songs, Tom Baker and Doctor Who, working with his heroes, Dee Snider, how Joe Satriani got involved, Marty Friedman’s guitar skills, casting Tommy Karevik and Simone Simons, doing everything different, trying to get the movie made with Dick Maas, performing live.

programme.title: Steve Lukather interview
programme.desc: Steve about being stuck at home, how I Found The Sun Again got made, where his passion for music comes from, Toto, Weezer’s cover of Toto, re-creating the 70s live sound, his admiration for George Harrison, getting anger out through a song, losing his best friends, why he got sober, his autistic son, Joe Walsh and Steve Winwood, capturing a real performance, worries about Covid-19, the longevity of Toto, working with Paul McCartney.

programme.title: Beth Hart interview
programme.desc: Beth about learning from gardening, magical moments, addressing personal issues, facing your problems and taking responsibility, singing Led Zeppelin songs, healing through music, recording vocals, Stairway To Heaven and No Quarter, getting honest feedback, other artists she would like to cover, writing new songs of her own, trying new things, being willing to fail and learn, her love for the Netherlands.

programme.title: Jerry Cantrell and Tyyler Bates interview
programme.desc: Jerry and Tyler about the John Wick 2 OST, the start of Brighten, their creative process together, using his time outside of Alice in Chains well, darkness and glimmers of hope, writing lyrics, letting the art speak for itself, having two drummers on the album, Greg Puciato’s harmonies, Travis’ thoughts on Alice in Chains, Jerry looking back at his early career, songs that defined the Alice in Chains sound.

programme.title: Eivør interview
programme.desc: Eivør about growing up in a secluded place, being close to nature, electronic and organic sounds, how she starts on a new album, the new album Segl, her creative force, opening up for collaborations, Only Love with Ásgeir, Let It Come, listening to your inner voice, contrasts, a crossroads in her life, creative freedom, the title Segl (sail), hope, Patience, making people feel something.

programme.title: Wardruna interview - Einar Selvik (2021)
programme.desc: Einar about hunting for songs, inspiration in nature, not wanting to repeat himself, the influence of Skald on the new record, building a strong foundation of knowledge, a multi-disciplinary approach, highlighting the things that universally resonate with people, learning from the past, the album Kvitravn, how he writes his songs, the title track, a flock of ravens around his house, letting a song be what it is, live performances, working on the Assassins Creed Valhalla game, how we remember history.

programme.title: Epica interview - Simone Simons
programme.desc: Simone about a forced sabbatical, what keeps her busy these days, the starting point of the new album Omega, writing together in the same room, finding the musical direction, revisiting Design Your Universe, The Skeleton Key, dreams and nightmares, fame vs privacy, Omega being a very diverse album, the Omega point, light vs darkness, Freedom – The Wolves Within, looking back at their earlier work, working with Ayreon on Transitus.

programme.title: Bennie Jolink interview
programme.desc: Bennie over z’n liefde voor tekenen, beginnen aan de nieuwe plaat en boek Bernard Jolink: Post Normaal, hoe muziek in z’n leven kwam, het op z’n eigen manier doen, success, het eerste grote optreden met Normaal, waarom boerenrock aansloeg, een rel bij TopPop, eigenwijsheid, Ik Goa Mien Eigen Gang, schrijven met Alan Gascoigne, Jamaica, jezelf niet te serieus nemen, roem, gezondheidsproblemen, Ij Moet Deur, moderne muziek, muziek dat hem raakt, Kameraad, z’n vriendschap met Jan Manschot, z’n allerlaatste optreden

programme.title: Five Finger Death Punch interview - Zoltan Bathory
programme.desc: Zoltan about being forced to take a break, what drives him, living life to the fullest, manifesting thoughts, wanting to be an astronaut, getting started on AfterLife, the band being polarizing, success and envy, fresh energy in the band, true creative freedom, the concept of AfterLife, a cultural paradigm shift, near-death experiences, spirituality, Judgement Day.

programme.title: Daughtry interview - Chris Daughtry
programme.desc: Chris about Heavy Is The Crown, the most liberating album he’s made, starting again from the ground up, going independent, the writing process for World On Fire, challenging himself vocally, finding his voice, Chris Cornell and covering ‘Hunger Strike’, going sober, mental health, dealing with his struggles through song.

programme.title: Sleaford Mods with jason Part 1
programme.desc: Jason about Teacher Faces Porn Charges, starting on the album English Tapas, current affairs, a hip hop influence, getting the working class tag, humor, self-reflection, Messy Anywhere, Andrew’s beats, getting critiqued, people’s opinions, the temperament of English people, Rough Trade, their music abroad, the live shows, genuine elation, having no pretense, professionalism

programme.title: Bastille interview - Dan Smith
programme.desc: Dan about the new album Give Me The Future, his modes of escaping the world, seeing Big Thief live, their music being about escapism, his style of songwriting, being more certain in what he wants to say, using sci-fi to tell stories with substance, Future Holds, a poem by Riz Ahmed, how we perceive the future, creating a fictional world for the album, songwriting as an escape, learning to be a frontman, how he feels on stage, having a #1 album again, what’s next for the band.

programme.title: Alt-J interview - Thom Sonny Green
programme.desc: Thom about taking a year off, getting ready for The Dream, Walk a Mile, having no expectations for the new album, channeling his feelings into music, Shakespeare, his passion for art, Philadelphia, their growing friendship within the band, Get Better, field recordings and playing with sound, thinking about another solo album.

programme.title: Steven Wilson interview
programme.desc: Steven about releasing an album during the pandemic, falling out of love with the guitar, the origins of his new album The Future Bites, living in an electronic world, Eddie van Halen, King Ghost, an exciting songwriting process, making the characters he writes about believable, creativity and technology, the internet changing human nature, the decline of truth and reality, positive change, the year 2032 an consumer culture, curiosity being under threat.

programme.title: Damien Jurado Interview
programme.desc: Damien about how his songs come to him, Bird Tricked Into The Tree, not overthinking music, an emphasis on his vocals, producing without friend Richard Swift, his inner voice, Ochoa, the album title What’s New, Tomboy?, the characters he writes about, artists vs entertainers, connecting through music, Oh Yeah by Bo Diddley.

programme.title: Bob Mould interview
programme.desc: Bob about his early fascination with music, songs he wrote when he was 9, discovering punk rock, The Ramones and Iggy Pop, forming Hüsker Dü, gaining attention, when the band fell apart, Workbook, his time in Sugar, his parents passing, moving to Berlin, writing for Sunshine Rock.

programme.title: Cindy Blackman interview
programme.desc: Cindy about The Quarantine Blues, a chance to reset, becoming better humans, her love for the drums, always looking to improve, singing a lot on the new album Give The Drummer Some, We Came To Play, Mother Earth, sharing music, bringing jazz to more people, not putting music into boxes, inspiration, the incredible jazz musicians she learned from, enjoying the little things.

programme.title: Countain Crows interview - Adam Duritz
programme.desc: Adam about visiting his friends farm in England, shaving his head, starting on the Butter Miracle EP, music being a personal thing for him, Tall Grass, the evolution of his songwriting, the ghosts from your childhood, learning how to live, a screw-up with the release, working on a second Butter Miracle suite, keeping true to the song, a trumpet solo, the album getting so much support, feeling responsible for his crew.

programme.title: Declan McKenna interview
programme.desc: Declan about his album Zeros, finding his place in music, playfulness, making observations about society, a positive sense of humanity, Daniel You’re Still a Child, The Social Dilemma documentary, turning off his notifications, the good and bad of social media, organic and raw sounds, good mistakes, capturing the right energy on the album, trusting yourself as a musician, taking control, finally getting the album out, his favorite lyric on the album.

programme.title: Sleaford Mods with jason Part 2
programme.desc: Jason about Teacher Faces Porn Charges, starting on the album English Tapas, current affairs, a hip hop influence, getting the working class tag, humor, self-reflection, Messy Anywhere, Andrew’s beats, getting critiqued, people’s opinions, the temperament of English people, Rough Trade, their music abroad, the live shows, genuine elation, having no pretense, professionalism

programme.title: Kevin Morby interview
programme.desc: Kevin about religion, the song Beautiful Strangers, the phrase “Oh My God”, showing religion from all angles, growing up in the midwest, working with Sam Cohen again, his vocals, writing on airplanes, Hail Mary, unconventional songs, talking his time with the album, a therapeutic element, the song OMG.

programme.title: Jack Savoretti interview
programme.desc: Jack about his new album Europiana, nostalgia about his childhood holidays, an education in music, finding a purpose behind what he does, scoring his second number one album, surrounding himself with the right people, writing on piano, the impact of the lockdown, working with Nile Rodgers, loving the notion of a full album, recording at Abbey Road and the magic in that studio, asking questions about true love.

programme.title: Eefje de Visser interview
programme.desc: Eefje over haar nieuwe plaat Bitterzoet, muziek voor in de auto, schrijven vanuit piano, haar thuisstudio, niet te braaf willen zijn, een internationaal gevoel, altijd beginnen bij de muziek, kritisch zijn op haar eigen teksten, beeldvorming, tegenstellingen, vluchten uit de realiteit, verloren potentie, zelf-bewustzijn, vol inspiratie zitten.

programme.title: HMLTD interview - Henry Spychaliski and Achilleas Sarantaris
programme.desc: Henry and Achilleas about memories of a good time in Amsterdam, being commodified, Loaded, wanting to make a cultural impact, getting dropped by Sony, a duty to the album, banding together, West of Eden, painting a picture of the world, music as celebration, immersive live shows, challenging the audience, imagination, a period of reflection.

programme.title: Larkin Poe_interview
programme.desc: Rebecca and Megan about playing for change, the power of music, unlearning some of their musical upbringing, trusting themselves, forging their own path, five years of growth, going to Nashville to record Blood Harmony, the art of pre-production, sibling harmonies, still surprising each other, ambition

programme.title: P.J. Morton interview
programme.desc: P.J. about the music he grew up with, the first song he ever wrote, his early career and learning about the industry, delving into production, his sound, digging deeper on Watch The Sun, his computer crashing, how the lockdowns influenced the album, Be Like Water, working with Nas and Stevie Wonder, Please Don’t Walk Away, catharsis through songwriting

programme.title: Blind Melon interview - Rogers Stevens and Christopher Thorn
programme.desc: Rogers and Christopher the early years of the band, realizing their dreams, Shannon Hoon filming the band all the time, the documentary All I Can Say, watching the footage for the first time, who they were back then, the night Shannon died, bittersweet moments, what kind of person Shannon was, how his mom reacted to the film, Change and Shannon’s voice, the randomness of life, how they handled Shannon’s death.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe
programme.desc: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game.

programme.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programme.desc: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programme.title: Bloomberg Brief
programme.desc: Bloomberg Brief delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance". Their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics. Bloomberg Originals traces how the practices that created Mato Grosso, Brazil’s agricultural heartland, are spilling into San Ignacio, Bolivia’s fastest-growing deforestation hotspot, and asks a simple question: what if preservation efforts in one country simply displace development to another?

programme.desc: As labor grows scarce, how can the land still yield abundant harvests? China-Thailand cooperation is providing solutions: machines for farmers, jobs in factories, and training for young agricultural engineers. Technology is more than equipment — it brings efficiency and hope.

programme.title: Cambodia's rice prawn=making more money!
programme.desc: Rice and prawn grow better together. Prawn loosens the soil and control pests, while rice cleans and oxygenates the water. One field, two harvests. A team from Shanghai Ocean University brought this eco-farming model to Cambodia, helping turn rice paddies into new sources of income.

programme.title: Laos farmers hack one season into many
programme.desc: Laos is transforming traditional agriculture into a modern locally-adapted system with the cooperation of China, applying benefits from a decade of seed innovation as well as the domestic development of potash resources. programme.title: Working as one: Three Chinese villages pool resources for shared growth
programme.desc: Three villages in Shandong run on one shared economic ledger. It is a rural experiment in resource re‑allocation, pointing to alternative possibilities for rural communities across the developing world. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN anchor Lincoln Humphries explores three villages in Dezhou, Shandong for their stories.

programme.title: The AI revolution is here - but are we ready for what comes next?
programme.desc: In this special joint episode of World Economic Forum and CGTN, hosts Robin Pomeroy from World Economic Forum and Guan Xin, CGTN Anchor, sit down with Professor Arun Sundararajan of New York University's Stern School of Business, a member of the WEF AI Governance Alliance and author of The Sharing Economy. They dive into the most pressing questions about artificial intelligence. programme.title: BizPodcast: Rate decision week in focus
programme.desc: The Fed raised rates for the first time in three years, while the Bank of Japan is set to make its move next. With energy prices elevated and inflation pressures persisting, central banks are turning more hawkish. Will tightening continue? And what does it mean for the dollar, yen, renminbi, bond yields, and gold? This week on BizTalk, we take a closer look at the new global rate cycle and its market impact.#BizTalk #BizPodcast

programme.title: Driscoll’s and Yunnan: Growing a blueberry business together
programme.desc: Yunnan Province in southwest China is emerging as a major hub for the blueberry production in the country, thanks to its favorable climate and growing expertise. For U.S. berry company Driscoll's, cooperation with growers in the province is creating new opportunities, from cultivation to sales, as demand for premium blueberries grows in China and across Asia.

programme.title: China-US partnerships fueling rapid growth
programme.desc: Starbucks landed in China when coffee was a novelty. Today, 1 in 5 stores globally is there. American fast food and retail giants placed the same bet, and cashed in. Now local brands are out-executing them. The fix? Partner with Chinese private equity. Here's why it's working, and what it means for both sides.

programme.title: The green bridge between China & US
programme.desc: In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

programme.title: Why we need openness&sharing in the Al era
programme.desc: Three years ago, ChatGPT was almost the only answer to the question, "Which LLM is best?" Today, the gap between top Chinese and US models has narrowed to just 2.7%, with the two taking turns wearing the crown. US firms run on China's low-cost open-source models, while Chinese labs build on US frontier research. Openness isn't idealism-it's pragmatism. This episode of Beyond Competition explains why.

programme.title: Why does a new drug require joint R&D?
programme.desc: China has a third of the world's innovative drugs-in-development, while the US contributes 55% of global biopharma R&D investment. When these strengths meet, multi-billion-dollar partnerships follow - and patients worldwide benefit. In this episode, we explore why drug development knows no borders.

programme.title: How fresh produce connects two agricultural powerhouses
programme.desc: China-US farm trade hit $14.1 billion in the first half of 2026, that's around $78 million worth agricultural produce crossing the Pacific every day. From American soybeans in China's soy milk to Chinese garlic on US supermarket shelves, one table feeds two nations. In episode, let's follow the food trade.

programme.title: Why is energy transition a shared challenge for China and the US?
programme.desc: In 2025, China added over 430 GW of new wind and solar capacity while the US added 53 GW - 80% of it solar and storage. Eight of every 10 solar modules worldwide are made in China, driving down global clean energy costs for everyone. In this episode, let’s explore why the energy transition demands cooperation, not walls.

programme.title: Why the aviation revolution depends on global collaboration

programme.desc: Born to Korean immigrant parents freed from indentured servitude in early twentieth century Mexico, Jerónimo Lim Kim joins the Cuban Revolution with his law school classmate Fidel Castro and becomes an accomplished government official in the Castro regime, until he rediscovers his ethnic roots and dedicates his later life to reconstructing his Korean Cuban identity. programme.title: Sky's The Limit
programme.desc: A documentary exploring the muralist movement: the art of painting over breathtaking heights. Windowless gable walls were graffiti painters’ early targets, particularly in urban areas under renovation, and since 2012, monumental graffiti is in full rebirth especially in Paris’ 13th arrondissement. Through a design thought as a décor, obliterating the blandness of the walls, artists skillfully revive these soulless surfaces.

programme.title: Dances with the Wind
programme.desc: ‘Fury Dance’ is a story about a Korean protest dancer, Sam-hun Lee. He fought for the democratization of South Korea in the ‘80’s through dance, while giving up his own dream to become a ballerino. The film takes the viewer through prominent events in South Korean history, as Sam-hun dances to soothe the souls of victims who were killed by the Korean national violence during the past 30 years. During the 1980 Gwangju Massacre however, Sam-hun developed a panic disorder. So he crosses through the Eurasian rail with difficulty when invited to attend a festival to dance in France. Through his journey, he attempts to overcome his claustrophobic fears in France, revisits his lost dream of becoming a ballerino in Russia, and dances for the Holocaust victims in Poland. Documented for 15 years, this film is dedicated to those who lost their noble lives while fighting for freedom against the unjust political power.
